controller_actions.task: Write module.py exposing solve(data) per the user contract: for each path string in data (do not mutate input), return normalized paths in order. Empty string raises ValueError. Leading '/' = absolute, else relative. Collapse repeated slashes, drop '.' segments, resolve '..' against preceding segment. Relative path that normalizes to nothing becomes '.'. Use only standard library, no I/O.

(['/a//b/./c/'] -> ['/a/b/c']); root stays '/' (['/', '//', '/a/..'] -> ['/', '/', '/']); relative that normalizes away becomes '.' (['./', 'a/..', '.'] -> ['.', '.', '.']); multiple paths preserve order (['a/b', '/x/../y'] -> ['a/b', '/y']). Only write test_cases.json.
